transform_rows_parallel: transform rows in parallel using multithreading for image, audio, and video feature types
transform_row_single: transform a single row by applying feature type conversions and storage client uploads
transform_rows_with_offset: transform a batch of dataset rows with an offset index and optional row index column
transform_rows_with_storage: transform rows requiring embedded storage for image, audio, or video cell values
transform_rows_error_handling: transform rows with error handling for corrupted images and post-processing failures
